title: Ijwi Ryanse Kwihebura
intro: Intambwe mu rugo aho ugutakaza gukurikira ugutakaza, yamara ijwi rimwe rituje ryanse kwihebura. Ihamagara rimwe gusa muri Korowani rihindura ukwihangana guhinduka ihinduka; woshobora gukurikirana ibimenyetso vy’umuntu ari inyuma y’iryo jwi?
clues: Nari ijwi ry’ukwihangana mu rugo aho imihezagiro yageragezwa n’ivyago.
Nagumye mu rugo rwari rufise ubusa kubera ukubura ubutunzi n’abana.
Nari nzi ko indwara yari yarateye n’uwo mugenzi, umubiri wiwe wari ubabaye.
Igihe umubabaro wariko urakomera cane, narahamagara n’ukwibutsa Allah.
Natanze itangazo rimwe: Allah ni Ukuri, rero mugumye mwihanganye.
Nahamagaye Ayyub mw’izina; hanyuma, Allah akuraho iyo mibabaro, asubizaho umuryango.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Gusigarana na Ayyub biciye mu gutakaza no kurwara, hanyuma ugasaba ukwihangana .
Kugabisha intumwa igororotse ngo ihebe umuryango w'abanyagitugu
Gusenga ngo havuke uruvyaro ruzoza .
Gusobanura indoto mw'ibohero ry'umwami
Kuronka umwana wizigiwe iruhande y'uruzi
trial.answer: Gusigarana na Ayyub biciye mu gutakaza no kurwara, hanyuma ugasaba ukwihangana .

location.label: Ikintu nyamukuru
options: Itangazo ry'uko Allah ari Ukuri n'ukwihangana birakenewe .
Igiti c'umusukoni kiri iruhande y'isoko
Ihamagara ryo kwubaka ubwato kure y'imiraba .
Indoto y'inyenyeri cumi n'imwe n'izuba rirashe
Igiseke catwarwa ku ruzi Nili .
location.answer: Itangazo ry'uko Allah ari Ukuri n'ukwihangana birakenewe .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Umubabaro wa Ayyub warakuweho maze umuryango wiwe urasubirana .
Umwana yari amaze igihe kirekire arindiriwe yarahawe inyuma y'isengesho ry'ingumba .
Umutware akiri muto yasobanuye imyaka indwi y’umusesekara n’ubukene .
Umwana yari yizigiwe yararokowe mu mazi atemba .
Imburi yari imbere y’umwuzure wo gutikiza .
outcome.answer: Umubabaro wa Ayyub warakuweho maze umuryango wiwe urasubirana .

verse: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire. (83:16)
